content: Crunchyroll added the first 12 mini-episodes of the television anime of Jinushi 's Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You ( Super no Ura de Yani Sū Futari ) manga on Wednesday.

title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie Stays at #2, 3rd Mononoke Film Opens at #6 in Japan
content: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie — Nintendo , Illumination , and Universal Pictures ' sequel to The Super Mario Bros. Movie — stayed at #2 in its sixth weekend. The film sold 151,000 tickets and earned 205,436,210 yen (about US$1.28 million) from Friday to Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Cyborg 009: Nemesis Anime Casts Saori Hayami as Cyborg 003
content: The staff of Ishimori Production 's Cyborg 009: Nemesis , a new anime based on Shōtarō Ishinomori 's Cyborg 009 manga, announced on Thursday that Saori Hayami will voice Cyborg 003/Francois Alnul in the series. Cyborg 003 can detect enemies even from far locations with her super hearing and super vision abilities.
author: ANN

title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket With You Releases First Six Episodes Early on Crunchyroll
content: Smoking Behind the Supermarket With You has received an early premiere on Crunchyroll ahead of its Summer 2026 debut, with the platform releasing the equivalent of the anime’s first six episodes available to stream now.

title: 11 Anime Coming to HIDIVE in June 2026
content: The second month of the exciting Spring 2026 anime season is finally here as some of the greatest anime of the year made their debut in April. The first month of the ongoing season includes some of the greatest anime ever, including Witch Hat Atelier, Nippon Sangoku , and many more.
